title: Fallback below the grammar length bound
statement: Let $F$ be a machine format, and suppose a Boolean string $\alpha$ parses as a paired header $bits$ and suffix $rest$. If $|rest| < (4k+5)3^{k+1}(v+1)$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes in $F$ and $v$ is the natural number represented by $bits$ in least-significant-bit-first binary, then decoding $\alpha$ returns the fallback code of $F$.
hypotheses_covered: The suffix length is strictly less than $(4k+5)3^{k+1}(v+1)$, with $k$ the format’s work-tape count and $v$ the binary value of $bits$
